title: Go outside safely
summary: Prepare the child for a walk without ignoring weather or adult permission.

title: Check weather
summary: Read rain and temperature context before choosing clothes.

title: Ask an adult
summary: Obtain an explicit decision from the adult who owns the permission gate.

title: Choose clothes
summary: Select a coat in cold weather, boots in rain and both when both conditions apply.

title: Adult permission and safe clothing
summary: The walk remains blocked until permission is granted and clothing matches the observed weather.

title: Unsafe departure
summary: The child could leave without permission or suitable clothing.

title: Parallel context checks
summary: Weather and permission are independent checks whose results join before the final gate.

title: Synthetic walk scenario
summary: A public-safe teaching scenario; it is not evidence of a real child's permission.
